description: This Java class 'DebugXaResource' extends 'GenericXaResource' and provides debugging functionality for XA transactions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages transaction commit and rollback operations, logging, and maintains a debug resource map.

classes.name: DebugXaResource
classes.description: A debugging wrapper for XA resources that tracks transaction XIDs and logs transaction states and exceptions.

methods.name: DebugXaResource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an exception with provided info or default.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Handles the commit phase of a transaction, removing its XID from the debug map and logging if verbose mode is on.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Handles the rollback phase, similar to commit, with logging.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists this resource in a transaction and adds it to the debug map.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs the current XID and exception details.
